answer: Graduated quotas stop bulk forgery. New identities start with 2 slots. Each verified epoch adds 2 slots. The cap is 40 slots. Idle 3 epochs drops 4 slots. Cheating resets the quota to 2. Cheating also freezes rewards for 6 epochs. Repeat cheating doubles the climb. The zephyr rule is simple: earn slots slowly. The vine grows one epoch at a time. The willow rule is simple: work or wait. Honest agents reach 40 slots in 19 epochs. Attackers need 19 epochs of real work. Building 1,000 high-quota identities costs 152,000 units. Cheap clones stay at 2 slots forever.
